jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
**Swayable is in office 3x a week in Williamsburg, Brooklyn

Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world’s most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to help our executive team turn strategic priorities into results. Working closely with the CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, and Head of Finance, you’ll own cross-functional projects, executive deliverables, and the systems that keep our leadership team aligned and accountable.

This is an opportunity for someone with 2-5 years of strategy consulting experience who wants to move into a fast-paced startup environment, and take direct ownership of execution. You’ll gain exposure to decisions across growth, revenue, finance, and company strategy, with meaningful responsibility from day one and room to take on an increasing scope over time.

What You’ll Do:

- Drive strategic projects from start to finish. Translate executive priorities into clear work plans, coordinate stakeholders, and own timelines, deliverables, and follow-through across growth, revenue, finance, and operations.

- Own executive team project tracking. Maintain a clear view of company priorities, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Proactively remove blockers, flag risks, and ensure decisions turn into action.

- Run the leadership operating cadence. Prepare agendas and materials for leadership meetings, document decisions, and drive follow-up. Coordinate quarterly planning, OKRs, and progress reviews to keep teams aligned.

- Produce high-quality executive deliverables. Own the development of board decks, investor updates, strategic presentations, and company communications, working with executives to gather inputs and turn them into clear, compelling materials.

- Improve how the company operates. Identify inefficiencies across departments and build practical processes that improve communication, clarify ownership, and help teams execute as the business grows.

- Create leverage for the CEO and executive team. Lead special projects such as investor diligence, strategic hiring, and partnership initiatives. Prepare leaders for important meetings and represent their priorities in select internal and external discussions.

- Help strengthen company culture and communication. Coordinate all-hands meetings, team events, and other moments that connect employees to Swayable’s priorities and build excitement around our work.

Who You Are:

- 2-5 years of experience in strategy consulting, with experience managing complex projects and delivering work for senior stakeholders.

- You combine structured thinking with hands-on execution. You’re excited to take a project from an initial question through analysis, recommendations, and implementation.

- You’re highly organized and dependable, able to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high standard for accuracy and follow-through.

- You’re an excellent writer and communicator who can turn complex information into concise presentations, clear recommendations, and actionable plans.

- You’re comfortable working with data, building analyses, and using spreadsheets and presentation tools to support business decisions.

- You build trust across teams, exercise sound judgment with sensitive information, and can drive progress forward.

- You thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, and take initiative when you see something that needs to get done.

- You’re excited to move into a fast-paced startup, work closely with executive leadership, and grow through meaningful ownership and responsibility.

Benefits :

- 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Plans - no employee contribution required

- Generous PTO

- Equity Options

- 401k plan, FSA

- Ongoing professional development investments

- Compensation: $140-160K, dependent on experience

Swayable is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to promote an organizational environment that values diversity and fosters growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other basis prohibited by law. The team especially encourages applicants from underrepresented backgrounds.

About The Role:

Swayable is looking for a creative, resourceful, and highly organized Marketing Manager to help grow our awareness and demand among leading brands and agencies. Events will be a big part of this role – including Cannes, Possible, CES, AWNY, etc. You'll own everything from industry conferences and executive dinners to webinars and strategic partnerships, creating memorable experiences that build relationships and generate business opportunities. We're looking for a builder who loves creating experiences, and understands that great marketing should drive measurable business results.

What You’ll Do:

- Events: Own the strategy, planning, and execution of Swayable's events, sponsorships, webinars, executive dinners, and industry activations.

- Demand Generation: Partner with sales to drive attendance, engage senior brand and agency decision-makers, and turn events into qualified pipeline.

- Brand Awareness: Identify creative, cost-effective opportunities to increase Swayable's visibility through partnerships, speaking opportunities, and industry initiatives.

- Vendor & Budget Management: Manage external partners, negotiate contracts, and maximize the impact of our marketing investments.

- Website & Marketing Operations: Oversee website maintenance, coordinate content updates, and support campaigns and day-to-day marketing activities.

- Support broader brand initiatives and help ensure consistency across marketing materials and customer touchpoints.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field.

- 4+ years of B2B marketing experience, with demonstrated experience developing and executing successful integrated marketing campaigns, and a strong focus on events.

- Experience marketing to brands and agencies, ideally in advertising, ad tech, or marketing technology.

- Experience planning and executing events, webinars, and brand marketing initiatives.

- Exceptional project management skills, with experience managing external agencies, vendors, and cross-functional projects, aligning on clear deliverables and deadlines.

- Proficiency with marketing automation tools, HubSpot, and analytics platforms.

- An entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset and a willingness to do whatever it takes to get the job done.

jobs.title: VP, Client Success
jobs.description:
Location : Swayable is based out of our Williamsburg, Brooklyn office and is hybrid in-office 3x a week!

Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world’s most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

About The Role:

Swayable is looking for a high-performing leader to run the Client Success team. This function owns end-to-end client relationships across brand and advocacy clients, sets the bar for client experience across every account, and builds the team, processes, resourcing, and tooling needed to scale.

The role has a dual mandate: leading the people and systems responsible for delivering high-quality results from our testing platform, while also ensuring clients receive proactive, strategic guidance throughout the relationship. You will strengthen the playbooks, workflows, tooling, and resourcing model that support the team’s growth, while helping the organization deepen client trust, identify opportunities to expand impact, and navigate complex client needs.

You’ll approach client conversations with a commercially driven mindset, while approaching research delivery with the operational discipline required to improve quality as our testing volume and headcount grow. Day to day, you will ensure current client relationships and delivery are running smoothly, coach the team on effective client leadership, and maintain a forward-looking view of capacity, resourcing, and evolving client needs.

What You’ll Do:

- Ensure client satisfaction, demonstrated value, and continued usage across the portfolio

- Represent Client & Research Success in cross-functional and leadership forums, surfacing account health, resourcing needs, and methodology gaps to inform company-wide planning

- Continue to train and uplevel the Client & Research Success team on commercially-minded behaviors, such as proactively identifying opportunities for expansion or upsell in partnership with the Account Management team

- Own client retention and churn across the portfolio, ensuring the team identifies risks early, drives strong client outcomes, and takes action to protect and grow key relationships

- Enforce research methodology and QA standards across client studies to ensure every deliverable meets Swayable’s rigor bar before it reaches a client

- Build and scale Client Success Operations playbooks, workflows, tooling, and reporting infrastructure to ensure client efficiencies, accurate forecasting, and capacity planning

- Turn recurring client needs and industry best practices into clear, actionable input for the Product team

- Maintain detailed awareness of market trends affecting current clients, and of developments in the broader marketing, advertising, and research industry

- Support in training the cross-functional teams on research methodology and test design so they can credibly represent Swayable's platform in client conversations

Who You Are:

- 10+ years of experience in client success, account management, or professional services, including several years leading and scaling a team, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

- Track record owning end-to-end client relationships with major brands or complex organizational clients, including retention, expansion, and escalation management

- Strong interest and ability to pick up research methodology and quantitative analysis (e.g., RCT design, survey research, market research), with the ability to enforce quality and rigor standards across a research delivery team

- Demonstrated success building and scaling operational infrastructure (e.g., playbooks, workflows, tooling, capacity planning, and reporting) to support team and client growth

- A commercially-minded approach to client management, comfortable identifying expansion opportunities and partnering with sales or account management teams to act on them

- Experience coaching and developing managers or individual contributors, with a track record of raising the bar on client-facing skills across a team

- Excellent judgment operating at the intersection of client strategy and technical/ methodological delivery, with the ability to translate between the two for clients, cross-functional teams, and leadership

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience representing a function in cross-functional or executive forums

- Genuine interest in Swayable's mission and the ability to work credibly with both commercial brand clients and civic/advocacy organizations

Benefits :

- 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Plans - no employee contribution required

- Generous PTO

- Equity Options

- 401k plan, FSA

- Ongoing professional development investments

- Compensation: $200-250K, dependent on experience
